item.title: Qatar consumer prices dip 0.01% in October, up 3.33% on the year
item.description:
Qatar's Consumer Price Index stood at 103.91 points in October 2026, down 0.01% from September and up 3.33% from October 2025, according to National Planning Council data released on Wednesday. The monthly dip was led by clothing and footwear, down 2.98%, and transport, down 0.58%, while health rose 1.18%. Year on year, food and non-alcoholic beverages climbed 14.34%.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/npc-qatar-records-slight-decline-in-consumer-prices-in-october-2026 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-records-slight-decline-in-consumer-prices-in-october-2026 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266412/latest-news/qatar-records-slight-decline-in-consumer-prices-in-october-2026 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/المجلس-الوطني-للتخطيط-انخفاض-طفيف-لأسعار-المستهلك-بالدولة-في-أكتوبر-2026

item.title: Cabinet approves 2026-2030 human rights plan and Kahramaa reorganisation
item.description:
The Cabinet, at its weekly meeting on Wednesday chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, approved a draft Amiri decision reorganising the Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation (Kahramaa) and the draft National Human Rights Action Plan 2026-2030. It noted that Qatar ranked first globally for the second year in technology development financing and big data use in the IMD 2026 World Digital Competitiveness ranking.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/cabinet-holds-weekly-meeting · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266411/latest-news/cabinet-welcomes-amirs-european-tour-approves-national-human-rights-plan-and-kahramaa-reorganisation · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/مجلس-الوزراء-يوافق-على-مشروع-قرار-أميري-بإعادة-تنظيم-المؤسسة-العامة-القطرية-للكهرباء-والماء

item.title: Qatar and US sign AI agreement and critical minerals MoU
item.description:
Qatar and the United States signed an agreement and an MoU in Washington to boost cooperation in artificial intelligence, critical minerals and rare earth elements, on the sidelines of the eighth Strategic Dialogue co-chaired by Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Minister of State for Foreign Trade Dr. Ahmed bin Mohammed Al Sayed and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick signed it, and a high-level trade and investment session was held.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-us-sign-agreement-and-mou-to-expand-cooperation-in-ai-critical-minerals · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266399/latest-news/qatar-us-sign-agreement-and-mou-to-expand-cooperation-in-ai-critical-minerals · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qatar-us-stress-importance-of-advancing-economic-partnership

item.title: Qatar and Turkiye hold sixth joint security committee in Doha
item.description:
Assistant Undersecretary of the Ministry of Interior for Security Affairs Sheikh Nayef bin Faleh Al-Thani met Turkiye's Director General of Security Ali Fidan in Doha on Wednesday to discuss expanding security cooperation. The sixth Joint Qatar-Turkiye Security Committee convened after the meeting to enhance coordination and expertise-sharing between the relevant authorities.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qatar-and-turkiye-discuss-strengthening-security-cooperation-in-doha-talks · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/assistant-undersecretary-of-moi-receives-turkish-director-general-of-security

item.title: QIIB issues $500 million sukuk at 5.908% yield
item.description:
QIIB issued $500 million of five-year senior unsecured sukuk under its $2 billion programme listed on the London Stock Exchange, with orders reaching about three times the issue size. The sukuk was priced at 120 basis points over five-year US Treasuries, for a final yield of 5.908% a year.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qiib-successfully-issues-500-million-senior-unsecured-sukuk · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/الدولي-الإسلامي-ينجح-في-إصدار-صكوك-بقيمة-500-مليون-دولار-أمريكي-لأجل-خمس-سنوات

item.title: Fan travel packages for FIBA World Cup Qatar 2027 launch tomorrow
item.description:
The Local Organising Committee for the FIBA Basketball World Cup Qatar 2027 signed a partnership with Qatar Airways Holidays on Wednesday to offer dedicated fan travel packages, launching on 26 November. Separately, the Qatar Basketball Federation appointed Tunisian Hatem Mamlouk as senior team head coach, succeeding Turkish coach Hakan Demir, ahead of home games against South Korea on 26 November and Japan on 29 November at Al Janoub Hall.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qatar-2027-basketball-world-cup-partners-with-qatar-airways-holidays-to-offer-fan-travel-packages · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266408/latest-news/fiba-basketball-world-cup-qatar-2027-fans-to-get-dedicated-travel-packages-through-qatar-airways-holidays · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/إطلاق-باقات-السفر-لجماهير-كأس-العالم-لكرة-السلة-قطر-2027 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/hatem-mamlouk-appointed-qatar-basketball-team-coach

item.title: Al Sadd lose 2-1 to Al Nassr, stuck on two points
item.description:
Al Sadd lost 2-1 to Saudi side Al Nassr in Riyadh on Tuesday night in the fifth round of the AFC Champions League Elite. Cristiano Ronaldo scored a 13th-minute penalty and Mohammed Waad equalised in the 22nd minute before being sent off in first-half stoppage time; Joao Felix settled it with an overhead kick in the 52nd minute. Al Sadd remain on two points in 14th place.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/السد-يواصل-النزيف-آسيويا · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/acl-elite-felix-stunner-gives-al-nassr-win-over-10-man-al-sadd

item.title: Met department warns of fog tonight as Al Zubana season begins
item.description:
The Qatar Meteorology Department warned of low horizontal visibility on parts of the coast tonight, dropping to 2 km or less with fog until 6am on Thursday, with a forecast low of 22°C in Doha. It said the 13-day Al Zubana season began on Tuesday 24 November, the last phase of autumn, bringing greater chances of rain and storms.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/25/الأرصاد-الجوية-تحذر-من-رؤية-أفقية-متدنية-على-بعض-مناطق-الساحل-الليلة · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-sees-increased-chances-of-rain-as-al-zubana-star-rises

item.title: Coalition strikes Hodeidah port as Houthis threaten Saudi Red Sea ports
item.description:
The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said it struck Houthi operational capabilities at Hodeidah port at dawn on Wednesday and destroyed targets in Saada and Amran, after urging civilians to evacuate the port. The Houthis threatened to hit Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports and told shipping firms to withdraw their vessels. Hodeidah is a key entry point for food and aid into Yemen.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345297 · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-attacks-after-hodeidah-strike · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-7-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-25-1.500760833

item.title: Houthis claim Ras Tanura refinery strike; Riyadh does not confirm
item.description:
The coalition said it intercepted four drones over Ras Tanura in the Eastern Province on Wednesday morning, with debris falling but no casualties in an initial assessment. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed the group attacked the Ras Tanura refinery and set it ablaze; satellite imagery reviewed by Reuters showed heavy black smoke around the refinery, while Saudi authorities have not confirmed the facility was hit.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/coalition-says-air-defenses-intercepted-and-destroyed-4-drones-in-saudi-arabiaas-ras-tanura · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-7-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-25-1.500760833 · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-attacks-after-hodeidah-strike

item.title: Saudi Arabia approves 2027 budget with SR1.392 trillion spending
item.description:
The Saudi Council of Ministers, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman, approved the 2027 state budget, with estimated revenues of SR1.201 trillion, spending of SR1.392 trillion and a projected deficit of SR190.56 billion. The Crown Prince stressed the resilience of the Saudi economy through 2026 despite regional crises.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666497/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-unveils-2027-state-budget-with-sr1201-trillion-revenues-and-sr1392-trillion-expenditures · Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345528 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/saudi-arabia-approves-2027-budget

item.title: IRGC says two oil tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy said on Wednesday that two oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, causing explosions and fires in their engine rooms, while transiting what Tehran calls an unauthorised route. Iranian army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia announced new systems to monitor the strait, and Tehran links a return to normal shipping to Washington meeting its demands, including lifting the naval blockade.
Sources: Rudaw https://www.rudaw.net/english/categories/iran/1080307 · WHTC (Reuters) https://whtc.com/2026/11/25/iran-says-ships-hit-mines-in-hormuz-warns-vessels-to-coordinate-passage/ · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194168

item.title: Washington urges citizens to leave Iran immediately, tightens regional warnings
item.description:
The US Virtual Embassy in Iran told Americans on Wednesday to leave Iran immediately, warning that hostilities could escalate rapidly. The US Mission to the UAE urged Americans across the Middle East to exercise heightened vigilance and avoid large gatherings, and said the embassy in Abu Dhabi would close from 26 to 29 November for Thanksgiving.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666529/world/us-tells-citizens-to-leave-iran-immediately-warns-hostilities-could-escalate-fast · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-7-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-25-1.500760833

item.title: Kuwait hosts meeting to activate GCC unified forward military command
item.description:
Kuwait is hosting a coordination meeting of the GCC unified forward military command from 24 to 26 November to complete arrangements for establishing and activating it in the country, the Kuwaiti army general staff said. The meeting aims to develop joint military work and raise defence coordination among GCC armed forces.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345181 · Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54291/kuwait/gcc-military-command-holds-coordination-meeting-in-kuwait/

item.title: Khalid bin Salman discusses Houthi and Iranian attacks with Bahrain and Netherlands
item.description:
Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman held phone calls with Bahrain's National Security Adviser Lt Gen Sheikh Nasser bin Hamad Al Khalifa and Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Dilan Yeşilgöz-Zegerius on defence ties and regional developments. The call with Bahrain covered Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Iranian attacks on Bahrain.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345499 · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666530/saudi-arabia/saudi-defense-minister-discusses-regional-security-with-bahraini-and-dutch-officials

item.title: Scatec plans $5 billion investment in Egypt over two years
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi received the chief executives of Norway's Scatec, Korea's NanoH2O and France's Veolia on Wednesday, with the electricity and housing ministers present. Scatec's chief announced new investments of about $5 billion over two years in renewables, storage and green data centres, and the President directed localising the manufacture of desalination plant components.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632168 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084292 · Vetogate https://www.vetogate.com/5777998 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/255954

item.title: Maersk resumes Suez Canal operations, completing network return
item.description:
President Sisi received A.P. Moller-Maersk CEO Vincent Clerc on Wednesday, with the transport minister and the Suez Canal Authority chairman present. Clerc said the company had resumed operations through the Suez Canal and the Red Sea and would complete the return of its full network over the coming months as security stabilises, adding that the canal remains Maersk's preferred route.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632116 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/255889

item.title: Cabinet approves strategic objectives agreement with the United States
item.description:
The Cabinet, chaired by Dr. Mostafa Madbouly on Wednesday, approved a draft presidential decree on a strategic objectives agreement with the United States for mutual prosperity, covering electricity, irrigation, agriculture, education and aviation. It also approved $470,000 in IFAD financing and widened the EGP30 billion priority-industries initiative to cover working capital.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084372 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535814 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194227

item.title: Egyptian bourse loses EGP39.3 billion as EGX30 falls 0.68%
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange's benchmark EGX30 fell 0.68% to 50,538.66 points at Wednesday's close, and the EGX70 dropped 1.32% to 16,886.71. Market capitalisation lost about EGP39.3 billion to EGP3.9713 trillion, as Egyptian investors were net sellers of EGP158.5 million while foreigners were net buyers of EGP121.9 million.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/25/3084334 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/102735

item.title: Gold 21-carat slips to about EGP5,550 at midday
item.description:
Gold kept falling in Egypt on Wednesday, with 21-carat at about EGP5,550 a gram at midday according to Masrawy, after EGP5,570 at the open, and the gold pound down to EGP44,400-44,560. The move tracked the global ounce falling to around $3,520.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/25/3084259 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194186

item.title: Government denies subsidised fertiliser shortage as winter season starts
item.description:
The Cabinet media centre denied on Wednesday any shortage of subsidised fertiliser, saying, after contacting the agriculture ministry, that producers continue to supply set quotas regularly to agricultural cooperatives as the winter season starts. The ministry said distribution runs through the Farmer Card system at official prices with no increase.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632252 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535835

item.title: EgyptAir wins best African air connectivity award
item.description:
EgyptAir won the award for best contribution to air connectivity within Africa for its 2025 operations at the 58th AFRAA General Assembly in Libreville, Gabon, held from 22 to 24 November. Holding company chairman Captain Ahmed Adel received the award.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535806 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7632242

item.title: Sami Qamsan takes over at Al Ahly, succeeding Hussein Ammouta
item.description:
Al Ahly appointed Sami Qamsan as first-team head coach, succeeding Morocco's Hussein Ammouta, and Arab Contractors bade him farewell and handed the job to Talaat Moharam. Debate surrounds an Egyptian FA rule barring a coach who seeks to end his contract from coaching another club in the same competition that season.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535864 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193879

item.title: Washington proposes tariffs of up to 20% on 14 economies
item.description:
The US Trade Representative's office on Wednesday proposed tariffs of up to 20% on 14 economies, including China, the EU, India, Japan and South Korea, after an eight-month Section 301 probe into excess capacity. China faces 20%, the joint highest, and the proposals are subject to public comment before taking effect.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345567 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/economy/trump-proposes-new-tariffs-of-up-to-20-on-14-economies-including-china-eu-and-india-1.500760754

item.title: US PCE inflation accelerates to 3.8%, core to 3.3%
item.description:
The US personal consumption expenditures price index rose 3.8% year on year in October, in line with forecasts, while core PCE rose 3.3%, above the expected 3.2% and the highest since 2023. Real consumer spending was little changed, reinforcing expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345553 · Morningstar https://www.morningstar.com/economy/october-pce-report-pce-inflation-index-up-38-line-with-expectations · StockAnalysis https://stockanalysis.com/news/us-pce-inflation-october-2026/

item.title: Gold falls below $3,500 for first time since September 2025
item.description:
Gold fell below $3,500 an ounce on Wednesday for the first time since September 2025, pressured by a stronger dollar and markets almost fully pricing a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. The metal has lost about 37% from its record high in January 2026.
Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat https://aawsat.com/node/5345515 · Coinpaper https://coinpaper.com/39400/why-is-gold-falling-today-gold-drops-below-3-500-as-dollar-strengthens

item.title: RSF drones kill at least 14 in Damazin
item.description:
At least 14 people, including children, were killed in Rapid Support Forces drone attacks on Damazin, capital of Blue Nile state, on Tuesday evening, a medical source told AFP, while the Emergency Lawyers group put the toll at 19. The attacks hit residential areas and power facilities in Damazin and a dam in Roseires.
Sources: Gulf Times (AFP) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738987/international/africa/drone-attack-in-southeast-sudan-kills-14-medical-source · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/overnight-rsf-drone-attacks-kill-19-in-sudan

item.title: Israeli strike kills north Gaza internal security chief and family
item.description:
An Israeli strike at dawn on Wednesday killed Mohammed Abu al-Awf, director of the Internal Security Service in northern Gaza, with his wife and children at their home in Shati camp west of Gaza City, according to Gaza's interior ministry and Hamas. Israeli attacks killed at least seven Palestinians in the Strip on Wednesday.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/israeli-strike-kills-hamas-official-his-wife-and-children · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084384

item.title: Eisenkot secures Lieberman in first coalition deal
item.description:
Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party said on Tuesday it agreed to sign a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's Israel Our Home, the first such alliance since the 27 October election, and made headway in talks with United Torah Judaism. Eisenkot has until 6 December to form a government, extendable by 14 days.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/israels-eisenkot-secures-first-coalition-partner-in-bid-to-form-government · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666516/world/eisenkot-clinches-first-coalition-agreement-makes-headway-in-talks-with-ultra-orthodox-party

item.title: Iraq top court allows federal forces on Kurdistan region borders
item.description:
Iraq's Federal Supreme Court ruled on Wednesday that the federal government may deploy forces to secure the international borders, including areas run by the Kurdistan region, and oversee border crossings. The ruling comes amid concerns over oil smuggling into Iran, while Kurdish authorities oppose the move as unconstitutional.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7194172 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-7-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-25-1.500760833

item.title: Six dead, 26 trapped in flooded Indonesian gold mine
item.description:
Rescuers recovered three more bodies on Wednesday from a flooded unlicensed gold mine in Bogor, West Java, raising the confirmed toll to six. Police said 26 workers had yet to be evacuated from the 100-metre-deep mine, flooded when a nearby river overflowed after heavy rain on Monday.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666531/world/six-confirmed-dead-as-rescuers-search-for-dozens-trapped-in-flooded-indonesia-gold-mine · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/25/rescuers-search-for-dozens-trapped-in-flooded-indonesia-gold-mine
